# Grass

**Tags:** `material`

Living turf that covers most temperate and twilight ground. It is the top face of natural land, tinted per biome; digging it turns it into Soil.

> **Goal:** Make natural ground read as ground, and give the surface layer a name the biomes can point at

## Fields

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| ---- | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `density` | decimal | yes | g/cm³; loose, root-bound |
| `hardness` | decimal | yes | Mohs equivalent 1–10 |
| `depthBand` | json | yes | Depth band [min, max) in world units below the natural surface where a vein may form; empty when max <= min. A surface cover, never a buried vein. |
| `leyGated` | boolean | yes | True when a vein of this material forms only near a ley line |
